panels.title: Active users, last 24h
panels.description: Installs that opened a Gentle AI session in the last 24 hours; each install reports at most once per day, so shorter windows undercount.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 86400) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Active users, last 6h
panels.description: Distinct installs seen in the last six hours provide a directional view of recent tool use.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 21600) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 21600) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Active users, last 1h
panels.description: Distinct installs seen in the last hour provide a directional view of immediate tool use.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 3600) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 3600) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Active users, last 15 min
panels.description: Distinct installs seen in the last 15 minutes provide a directional view of live tool use.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 900) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active users" FROM events WHERE received_at >= (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) - 900) * 1000000000 AND received_at <= CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Unique installs all-time
panels.description: All installations ever observed, counted once regardless of the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Unique installs" FROM events HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Unique installs" FROM events HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Active installs yesterday
panels.description: Installations active on the latest completed rollup day, which normally represents yesterday.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Active installs" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Active installs" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'active_install') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Active installs in range
panels.description: Distinct installations that reported activity during the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active installs" FROM events WHERE received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active installs" FROM events WHERE received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: New installs in range
panels.description: Distinct new installations first reported during the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "New installs" FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "New installs" FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Heartbeats in range
panels.description: Repeat activity signals received during the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Heartbeats FROM events WHERE event = 'heartbeat' AND received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Heartbeats FROM events WHERE event = 'heartbeat' AND received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: RDD adoption %
panels.description: Share of installations on the latest completed rollup day that had receipt-driven development enabled.

targets.queryText: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'true' THEN value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN key IN ('true','false') THEN value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "RDD adoption" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'rdd_enabled' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'rdd_enabled') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN key = 'true' THEN value ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN key IN ('true','false') THEN value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "RDD adoption" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'rdd_enabled' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'rdd_enabled') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: npm downloads latest day
panels.description: Combined public npm downloads for Gentle Pi and Gentle Engram on the latest collected day.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(value) AS "npm downloads" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(value) AS "npm downloads" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'npm_downloads_day') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: GitHub release downloads
panels.description: Cumulative downloads across all release tags on the latest collected GitHub snapshot.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(value) AS "Release downloads" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(value) AS "Release downloads" FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'github_release_downloads_total') HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

panels.title: Daily active installs
panels.description: Distinct installations active on each day within the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active installs" FROM events WHERE received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Active installs" FROM events WHERE received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Daily new installs
panels.description: Distinct new installations first reported on each day within the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "New installs" FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(received_at / 1000000000, 'unixepoch')) AS INTEGER) AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS "New installs" FROM events WHERE event = 'install' AND received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Cumulative unique installs
panels.description: All-time unique installations accumulated by first-seen day and displayed across the selected time range.

targets.queryText: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT install_id, date(MIN(received_at) / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS day FROM events GROUP BY install_id), daily AS (SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS new_installs FROM first_seen GROUP BY day), cumulative AS (SELECT day, SUM(new_installs) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS installs FROM daily) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS time, installs AS "Cumulative installs" FROM cumulative WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) * 1000 >= ${__from} AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) * 1000 <= ${__to} ORDER BY time ASC
targets.rawQueryText: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT install_id, date(MIN(received_at) / 1000000000, 'unixepoch') AS day FROM events GROUP BY install_id), daily AS (SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS new_installs FROM first_seen GROUP BY day), cumulative AS (SELECT day, SUM(new_installs) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS installs FROM daily) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) AS time, installs AS "Cumulative installs" FROM cumulative WHERE CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) * 1000 >= ${__from} AND CAST(strftime('%s', day) AS INTEGER) * 1000 <= ${__to} ORDER BY time ASC

panels.title: Agent adoption
panels.description: Install counts by detected coding agent on the latest completed rollup day.

targets.queryText: SELECT key AS Agent, SUM(value) AS Installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'agent' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'agent') GROUP BY key ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT key AS Agent, SUM(value) AS Installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'agent' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'agent') GROUP BY key ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Component adoption
panels.description: Install counts by enabled Gentle AI component on the latest completed rollup day.

targets.queryText: SELECT key AS Component, SUM(value) AS Installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'component' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'component') GROUP BY key ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT key AS Component, SUM(value) AS Installs FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'component' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'component') GROUP BY key ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: OS and architecture
panels.description: Distinct installations by operating system and CPU architecture during the selected time range.

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(os, ''), 'unknown') || '/' || COALESCE(NULLIF(arch, ''), 'unknown') AS Platform, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS Installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 GROUP BY Platform ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 1000
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(os, ''), 'unknown') || '/' || COALESCE(NULLIF(arch, ''), 'unknown') AS Platform, COUNT(DISTINCT install_id) AS Installs FROM events WHERE received_at >= ${__from} * 1000000 AND received_at <= ${__to} * 1000000 GROUP BY Platform ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Version adoption
panels.description: Top ten reported Gentle AI versions on the latest completed rollup day.

targets.queryText: WITH normalized AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(key, '-') > 0 THEN substr(key, 1, instr(key, '-') - 1) || ' (main)' ELSE key END AS Version, value FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'version' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'version')) SELECT CAST(Version AS TEXT) AS Version, SUM(value) AS Installs FROM normalized GROUP BY Version ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 10
targets.rawQueryText: WITH normalized AS (SELECT CASE WHEN instr(key, '-') > 0 THEN substr(key, 1, instr(key, '-') - 1) || ' (main)' ELSE key END AS Version, value FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'version' AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM rollups_daily WHERE metric = 'version')) SELECT CAST(Version AS TEXT) AS Version, SUM(value) AS Installs FROM normalized GROUP BY Version ORDER BY Installs DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Deliveries, last 15 min
panels.description: This anonymous activity counts agent responses, not people, and shows telemetry deliveries received in the last 15 minutes. VictoriaMetrics: increase() over a fixed 15-minute window (matches the original SQL's now-900s filter, independent of the dashboard time range).

panels.title: Responses, last 15 min
panels.description: This anonymous activity counts agent responses, not people, received in the last 15 minutes. VictoriaMetrics: increase() over a fixed 15-minute window.

panels.title: Tokens processed, last 15 min
panels.description: This anonymous activity counts agent responses, not people, and totals their derived token volume over the last 15 minutes. VictoriaMetrics: increase() over a fixed 15-minute window, summing input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning kinds (excludes kind="total").

panels.title: Hosts active, last 15 min
panels.description: This anonymous activity counts agent responses, not people, and shows distinct reporting host types over the last 15 minutes. VictoriaMetrics: counts distinct host label values with a nonzero 15-minute delivery increase.

panels.title: Responses per minute by host (last 3h)
panels.description: This anonymous activity counts agent responses, not people, and shows their per-minute host distribution over the last three hours. VictoriaMetrics: per-minute increase() for each of the four known hosts (matches the original SQL's fixed host columns; other hosts are not plotted, same as before).

panels.title: Tokens processed per minute (last 3h)
panels.description: This anonymous activity counts agent responses, not people, and shows their derived token volume per minute over the last three hours. VictoriaMetrics: per-minute increase(), summing input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning kinds.

panels.title: Tokens processed
panels.description: Derived token volume processed by instrumented agents during the selected time range. VictoriaMetrics: increase() over the dashboard's selected time range ($__range); the dashboard's default time.from is 2026-09-10, matching the start of the backfilled history.

panels.title: Responses
panels.description: Response occurrences reported by instrumented agents during the selected time range. VictoriaMetrics: increase() over the dashboard's selected time range.

panels.title: Deliveries
panels.description: Telemetry deliveries received from instrumented agent hosts during the selected time range. VictoriaMetrics: increase() over the dashboard's selected time range. Note: gentle_runtime_deliveries_total increments once per received delivery regardless of whether it carried any rows, while the original SQL inner-joined runtime_rows and so excluded zero-row deliveries; in practice every real delivery carries rows.

panels.title: Hosts reporting
panels.description: Distinct agent host types that reported runtime usage during the selected time range. VictoriaMetrics: counts distinct host label values with a nonzero delivery increase over the selected range. Same zero-row-delivery caveat as the Deliveries panel.

panels.title: Subagent coverage
panels.description: Share of observations attributed to a named subagent. VictoriaMetrics: ratio of increase() on gentle_runtime_rows_total with agent_class excluding orchestrator/unknown to the same metric's total increase, over the selected range.

panels.title: Responses by subagent
panels.description: Observed responses and launches show which named subagents ran most often. VictoriaMetrics: sum of increase() on gentle_runtime_responses_total plus gentle_runtime_launches_total, grouped by agent_class, excluding orchestrator/unknown, over the selected range.

panels.title: Tokens processed by subagent
panels.description: Derived token volume shows which named subagents handled the most model work. VictoriaMetrics: increase() on gentle_runtime_tokens_total grouped by agent_class (excluding orchestrator/unknown), summing input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning kinds, over the selected range.

panels.title: Subagent model and effort selection
panels.description: Shows which named subagent ran on which model and effort, together with launches, responses, and token volume. VictoriaMetrics: joins increase() on gentle_runtime_launches_total, gentle_runtime_responses_total and gentle_runtime_tokens_total (summed input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning kinds) grouped by host, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort, over the selected range. Known gap: model_evidence and effective_effort live only on the low-cardinality gentle_runtime_rows_by_evidence_total{host,model_evidence,effective_effort} series by design (bounded cardinality, see the feature's Design section) and cannot be joined against this breakdown, so the Evidence and Effective effort columns are not reproduced here.

targets.expr: sum by (host, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort) (increase(gentle_runtime_launches_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown"}[$__range]))
sum by (host, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort) (increase(gentle_runtime_responses_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown"}[$__range]))

sum by (host, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort) (increase(gentle_runtime_tokens_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown", kind=~"input|output|cache_read|cache_creation|reasoning"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Most popular models per subagent
panels.description: Ranks the community’s most observed models for each named subagent and shows the effort and hosts behind that usage. VictoriaMetrics: sum of increase() on gentle_runtime_responses_total plus gentle_runtime_launches_total grouped by agent_class, provider, model (excluding orchestrator/unknown), sorted by subagent then observations. Known gap: PromQL has no per-group Rank/percentage-share or string-aggregation primitive equivalent to the original SQL's window functions and group_concat, so the Rank, "Most common selected effort", "Share of subagent (%)" and "Hosts" columns are not reproduced; only Subagent, Provider, Model and Observations are shown.

targets.expr: sum by (agent_class, provider, model) (increase(gentle_runtime_responses_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown"}[$__range])) + sum by (agent_class, provider, model) (increase(gentle_runtime_launches_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Top model per subagent
panels.description: Highlights the most observed model for each named subagent across the selected time range. VictoriaMetrics: topk by (agent_class) (1, ...) selects the single top provider/model per subagent by combined increase() of responses_total plus launches_total, over the selected range. Known gap: the original single "Subagent and model" text column is now three separate columns (Subagent, Provider, Model) since PromQL/Grafana table transforms have no string-concatenation primitive; the barchart's xField now reads Subagent instead of the concatenated string.

targets.expr: topk by (agent_class) (1, sum by (agent_class, provider, model) (increase(gentle_runtime_responses_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown"}[$__range])) + sum by (agent_class, provider, model) (increase(gentle_runtime_launches_total{agent_class!~"orchestrator|unknown"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Usage by host, subagent, model and effort
panels.description: Answers which subagent used which model at which effort and how many tokens were processed. VictoriaMetrics: joins increase() on launches_total, responses_total and tokens_total (summed input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning) grouped by host, agent_kind, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort, over the selected range, including orchestrator/unknown (matches the original SQL, which did not filter them). Known gaps: effective_effort is not available at this label granularity (same cardinality-bound design as the Subagent model and effort selection panel) so that column is dropped; Provider and Model are shown as separate columns instead of the original concatenated "Provider/model" string.

targets.expr: sum by (host, agent_kind, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort) (increase(gentle_runtime_launches_total[$__range]))
sum by (host, agent_kind, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort) (increase(gentle_runtime_responses_total[$__range]))
sum by (host, agent_kind, agent_class, provider, model, selected_effort) (increase(gentle_runtime_tokens_total{kind=~"input|output|cache_read|cache_creation|reasoning"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Tokens processed by host
panels.description: Derived token volume compares runtime usage across supported agent hosts. VictoriaMetrics: increase() on gentle_runtime_tokens_total grouped by host, summing input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning kinds, over the selected range.

panels.title: Responses by host
panels.description: Reported response occurrences compare activity across supported agent hosts. VictoriaMetrics: increase() on gentle_runtime_responses_total grouped by host, over the selected range.

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Model-level usage keeps unknown and custom model evidence visible instead of hiding incomplete attribution. VictoriaMetrics: joins increase() on gentle_runtime_responses_total and gentle_runtime_tokens_total (summed input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning) grouped by host, provider, model, over the selected range. Known gap: model_evidence lives only on the separate low-cardinality gentle_runtime_rows_by_evidence_total series and cannot be joined against provider/model at this granularity, so the Evidence column is dropped.

panels.title: Responses and tokens by selected effort
panels.description: Selected reasoning effort shows how usage and token volume are distributed across requested effort levels. VictoriaMetrics: joins increase() on gentle_runtime_responses_total and gentle_runtime_tokens_total (summed input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning) grouped by selected_effort, over the selected range.

panels.title: Tokens processed per hour by host (last 24h)
panels.description: Hourly derived token volume over the last 24 hours shows recent runtime activity by host. VictoriaMetrics: hourly increase() per host, summing input+output+cache_read+cache_creation+reasoning kinds, for each of the four known hosts (same fixed-host-column semantics as the original SQL).

panels.title: Token coverage per field
panels.description: Coverage makes the reporting quality of every token field transparent for each host. VictoriaMetrics: for every (host, kind) pair, sums increase() on gentle_runtime_token_fields_total by state (reported/unavailable/unsupported) over the selected range; Reported % is computed directly in PromQL as 100 * reported / (reported+unavailable+unsupported). Unlike the original panel's six hardcoded UNION ALL blocks (Input/Output/Cache read/Cache creation/Reasoning/Total reported), this single query naturally covers all six token kinds (the kind label includes "total") in one table.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (host, kind) (increase(gentle_runtime_token_fields_total{state="reported"}[$__range])) / sum by (host, kind) (increase(gentle_runtime_token_fields_total[$__range]))

panels.title: Error observations by category
panels.description: Categorized error observations surface reliability signals without exposing error text. VictoriaMetrics: increase() on gentle_runtime_errors_total grouped by category, over the selected range. gentle_runtime_errors_total is only ever incremented for a non-empty, non-"none" category (see metrics.go Observe), so no extra filter is needed to reproduce the original SQL's <> 'none' clause.

panels.title: Measured duration by kind
panels.description: Average measured duration and observation count by available timing kind show how responsive instrumented activity is. VictoriaMetrics: joins increase() on gentle_runtime_duration_measured_total and gentle_runtime_duration_ms_sum grouped by duration_kind (excluding duration_kind="unavailable"), over the selected range; Average ms is computed as sum_ms / measured_count. Rows with zero measured count are filtered out, matching the original SQL's HAVING clause.
